/industries/accounting-bookkeeping/.title: AI training for Australian accounting and bookkeeping practices — AI at work
/industries/accounting-bookkeeping/.description: Practical AI training for accounting and bookkeeping practices. Claude and ChatGPT taught side by side, with the client-data line settled first. Built for practice owners and managers.

mainEntity.name: Our client data is confidential.

acceptedAnswer.text: It is, and it stays out. The tasks in the list above are drafting, chasing, restructuring and reading — none of them need a client identified. We settle that boundary in writing before the team touches a tool.

mainEntity.name: Won't it invent a tax position?

acceptedAnswer.text: It will, confidently, which is exactly why tax positions are on the never list. The training is about the writing and reading around the technical work, not the technical judgement.

mainEntity.name: My team will use it to avoid learning.

acceptedAnswer.text: That is a real risk with juniors and it gets addressed directly — the rule taught is that you have to be able to defend the output, so the reviewer's job doesn't get harder.

/industries/allied-health/.title: AI training for Australian allied health clinics — AI at work
/industries/allied-health/.description: AI training for allied health clinics, with the privacy line settled first. Built for practice owners and principals who carry the risk. Claude and ChatGPT taught side by side.

mainEntity.name: Isn't this a privacy breach waiting to happen?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is, if nobody has drawn the line. That's why the line comes first: which tool, which tier, which records, written down, before any productivity content.

mainEntity.name: My clinicians are already pasting notes in.

acceptedAnswer.text: Assume they are. That's the reason to move now, and the audit part of the engagement is designed to find out without turning it into a disciplinary process.

mainEntity.name: We can't afford clinician time out of the diary.

acceptedAnswer.text: Which is why the first session is short and aimed at the people who set the rules, not the whole clinic.

/industries/cleaning-maintenance/.title: AI for cleaning and property maintenance businesses — AI at work
/industries/cleaning-maintenance/.description: Quoting, scheduling messages, site reports and staff instructions for commercial cleaning and property maintenance businesses. Built with you on your own jobs.

mainEntity.name: My staff barely read the instructions now.

acceptedAnswer.text: That's usually a writing problem rather than a reading one, and it's the cheapest thing on this list to fix.

mainEntity.name: Tenders are too specific for AI.

acceptedAnswer.text: The specific parts are yours. The structure, the repeated content and the compliance schedule are not, and they're most of the document.

mainEntity.name: We're too busy to change anything.

acceptedAnswer.text: Then we build one thing — usually the monthly report or the quote — and leave the rest alone.

/industries/.title: AI training by industry — AI at work
/industries/.description: AI training tracks built from the real tasks of Australian accounting practices, real estate agencies, allied health clinics, law firms, NDIS providers, trades and cleaning businesses.

/industries/legal-conveyancing/.title: AI training for Australian law firms and conveyancers — AI at work
/industries/legal-conveyancing/.description: AI policy, audit and training for small law firms and conveyancing practices. Your staff are already using these tools. The question is how exposed the firm is.

mainEntity.name: The courts are hostile to this.

acceptedAnswer.text: Courts are hostile to unverified citations and undisclosed use, which is a different thing. The current practice notes in your jurisdiction are the starting material for the policy, not an obstacle to it.

mainEntity.name: We'd rather just ban it.

acceptedAnswer.text: A ban you can't enforce is worse than a rule people follow. The audit tells you which one you actually have.

mainEntity.name: Our PI insurer will have views.

acceptedAnswer.text: They will, and a written policy is what they will ask to see. Bring them into the scoping conversation.

/industries/ndis-providers/.title: AI training for NDIS and disability service providers — AI at work
/industries/ndis-providers/.description: Documentation, policy and AI training for NDIS providers. Built around audit readiness and a rule that holds across a large casual workforce.

mainEntity.name: Our support workers won't follow a policy.

acceptedAnswer.text: Most AI policies fail because they were written for office staff. The rule taught here has to work for someone on a shift with a phone, which changes how it is written.

mainEntity.name: We're mid-audit cycle.

acceptedAnswer.text: That's usually the best time. Documentation quality and evidence assembly is the work, and the audit gives it a deadline.

mainEntity.name: Isn't participant data completely off limits?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The productivity comes from structure, consistency and de-identified drafting, not from feeding records into a tool.

/industries/real-estate/.title: AI training for Australian real estate agencies and property managers — AI at work
/industries/real-estate/.description: AI training for real estate agencies and property management teams. Sales and PM run as separate sessions because the work barely overlaps. Claude and ChatGPT taught side by side.

mainEntity.name: My agents already use ChatGPT.

acceptedAnswer.text: Most of them do, on the free tier, with no rule about it. That's the argument for training rather than against it — the gap is not access, it's method and boundaries.

mainEntity.name: AI listing copy all sounds the same.

acceptedAnswer.text: It does when people accept the first draft. The session is mostly about getting output in your agency's voice and knowing which drafts to throw away.

mainEntity.name: Can we put sales and PM in one session?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can, and half the room will be bored for half the time. The tasks barely overlap. Two shorter sessions work better.

/industries/trades/.title: Same-day quoting and follow-up for trade businesses — AI at work
/industries/trades/.description: Get quotes out the same day and follow them up without thinking about it. Built with you, on your own jobs, for electrical, plumbing, HVAC and field service businesses.

mainEntity.name: I don't have time to sit in a course.

acceptedAnswer.text: Correct, so there isn't one. We build one workflow with you on your own jobs until it runs, and that's the engagement.

mainEntity.name: I'm not a computer person.

acceptedAnswer.text: The whole thing works by talking into your phone. If you can leave a voicemail you can do this.

mainEntity.name: Won't the quotes sound generic?

acceptedAnswer.text: They sound like you, because we build them from the quotes you already send. That's most of the work.
